l-e-m2-b03-05.title: Apa kabar ala tansah ana sawisé but?

l-e-m2-b03-05.material: Pratelan: Yèn ana but ing ukara, bab ala tansah ana sawisé but. Golekana ukara sing mbantah pratelan iki.
l-e-m2-b03-05.s.s1.prompt: Pilih ukara sing kabar apik ana sawisé but.
l-e-m2-b03-05.s.s1.r.b: Dadi adhem iku kabar ala. Cocog karo pratelan.
l-e-m2-b03-05.s.s1.r.c: Ora nduwèni mobil iku kabar ala. Cocog karo pratelan.
l-e-m2-b03-05.s.s1.r.d: Toko tutup iku kabar ala. Cocog karo pratelan.
l-e-m2-b03-05.s.s1.explain: But nyambungaké bab sing kosok balèn karo pérangan sadurungé. Yèn pérangan kapisan susah, sawisé kuwi bisa ana bab apik.
l-e-m2-b03-05.s.s2.model.0: Fun iku bab apik lan ana sawisé but, mula pratelan yèn sawisé but tansah ana bab ala iku salah.
l-e-m2-b03-05.s.s2.model.1: Fun ana sawisé kangèlan lelungan dawa, mula but mung nyambungaké gagasan kosok balèn lan ora tansah nuntun menyang kabar ala.

l-e-m2-b04-01.title: Apa the mesthi ana sadurunge superlative?
l-e-m2-b04-01.goal: Tliti apa pratelan “sadurunge superlative mesthi ana the” iku tansah bener, banjur goleki lan terangna conto sing ora bener (contoh sanggahan).
l-e-m2-b04-01.material: Pratelan: Ukara sing ngemot superlative kaya best, -est, utawa most mesthi nganggo the. Golekana ukara sing mbantah pratelan iki.
l-e-m2-b04-01.s.s1.r.a: Iki paling gedhé, mula ana the. Iki conto sing cocog karo pratelan.
l-e-m2-b04-01.s.s1.r.c: Iki paling adhem, mula ana the. Iki conto sing cocog karo pratelan.
l-e-m2-b04-01.s.s1.r.d: Iki sing paling apik, mula ana the. Iki conto sing cocog karo pratelan.
l-e-m2-b04-01.s.s1.explain: Wangun superlative saka adverb fast, yaiku fastest, bisa digunakake tanpa the. Dadi the ora mesthi kudu ana ing superlative.
l-e-m2-b04-01.s.s2.model.0: Ing “Our team ran fastest.” ora ana the sadurunge fastest, mula pratelan kuwi salah.
l-e-m2-b04-01.s.s2.model.1: Superlative saka adverb bisa digunakake tanpa the, mula pratelan yen mesthi ana the iku salah.

l-e-m2-b01-14.goal: Tliti sawetara conto aturan kanggo milih have utawa has ing present perfect, tulisen aturan sing koktemokake, banjur priksa nganggo conto anyar.
l-e-m2-b01-14.material: I have eaten. / You have eaten. / The dog has eaten. / The dogs have eaten. / It has rained. Temokake aturan sing mbedakake have lan has ing limang ukara iki.
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s1.prompt: Endi aturan sing bener sing koktemokake?
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s1.o.a: Yen jejeré wong katelu (3rd person) tunggal, gunakake has; saliyane iku, have
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s1.r.b: Dawane ukara ora nemtokake have utawa has.
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s1.o.c: Yen jejeré tunggal, mesthi gunakake has
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s1.r.c: I uga tunggal, nanging nganggo have.
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s1.o.d: Yen jejeré wong, have; yen kéwan, has
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s1.r.d: The dogs kéwan, nanging nganggo have.
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s1.explain: Jejer wong katelu tunggal (3rd person singular) kaya The dog lan It nganggo has, dene I, You, lan The dogs nganggo have.
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s2.model.0: Mung jejer wong katelu tunggal (3rd person singular) kaya The dog lan It sing nganggo has, dene I, You, lan The dogs nganggo have. Iki aturane.
l-e-m2-b01-14.s.s2.model.1: Ing ukara anyar The bird ___ flown, bird uga wong katelu tunggal (3rd person singular), mula has iku bener lan aturane kabukten.

l-e-m2-b02-12.title: Apa sing ana ing antarane as lan as?
l-e-m2-b02-12.goal: Tliti sawetara conto ungkapan as ~ as, tulisen aturan sing koktemokake, banjur priksa nganggo conto anyar.
l-e-m2-b02-12.material: My dog is as big as yours. The bus is as fast as the train. This song is as beautiful as that one. Delengen wangun tembung sipat ing antarane as lan as.
l-e-m2-b02-12.s.s1.prompt: Aturan apa sing koktemokake saka telung ukara kasebut?
l-e-m2-b02-12.s.s1.o.a: Gunakake tembung sipat wangun dhasar ing antarane as lan as
l-e-m2-b02-12.s.s1.o.b: Tambahake -er ing antarane as lan as
l-e-m2-b02-12.s.s1.r.b: Big, fast, lan beautiful ora nganggo -er.
l-e-m2-b02-12.s.s1.o.c: Gunakake more ing antarane as lan as
l-e-m2-b02-12.s.s1.r.d: Ora ana siji wae saka telung ukara sing nganggo than.
l-e-m2-b02-12.s.s1.explain: as ~ as tegesé “sepadhané ... karo ...”, lan ing antarane digunakake wangun dhasar, kayata big utawa fast.
l-e-m2-b02-12.s.s2.model.0: Ing kabeh telung ukara, wangun dhasar (big, fast, beautiful) ana ing antarane as lan as, mula aturane aja nambahake -er.
l-e-m2-b02-12.s.s2.model.1: Ukara anyar The box is as heavier as the bag krasa salah amarga -er, mula as heavy as iku sing bener. Aturane kabukten.

l-e-m2-b03-12.goal: Delengen sawetara conto aturan yèn sawisé tembung pitakon ana to + kriya dhasar, terangna aturané banjur priksa nganggo conto anyar.

l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s1.o.b: Tembung pitakon + to + kriya dhasar tegesé "apa/carane/ing ngendi... kudu nindakake"

l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s2.model.0: Ing telung ukara, sawisé tembung pitakon ana to + kriya dhasar, lan nyebut cara, panggonan utawa barang, mula aturane katon.
l-e-m2-b03-12.s.s2.model.1: Ing ukara anyar She knows when to leave, when to leave tegesé kapan dhèwèké kudu lunga, mula aturané cocog.

l-e-m2-b03-13.goal: Delengen sawetara conto aturan pasif nganggo kriya modal, terangna aturané lan priksa nganggo conto anyar.
l-e-m2-b03-13.s.s1.o.a: Mung modal verb + past participle sing digunakake
l-e-m2-b03-13.s.s1.r.a: Ora ditulis can grown, nanging ana be.
l-e-m2-b03-13.s.s1.o.b: Urutane be + modal verb + past participle
l-e-m2-b03-13.s.s1.r.b: Be ana sawisé modal verb, dudu sadurungé.
l-e-m2-b03-13.s.s1.o.c: Urutane modal verb + be + past participle
l-e-m2-b03-13.s.s1.o.d: Mung modal verb + kriya dhasar sing digunakake
l-e-m2-b03-13.s.s1.r.d: Ana past participle kayata grown, taken, lan graded.
l-e-m2-b03-13.s.s1.explain: Kaya can be grown, must be taken, lan will be graded, be ana sawisé kriya modal lan banjur past participle.
l-e-m2-b03-13.s.s2.model.0: Ing telung ukara, be mapan sawisé kriya modal lan sabanjuré past participle, mula urutan iki dadi aturan.
l-e-m2-b03-13.s.s2.model.1: Ukara anyar The door should be locked uga nduwé should + be + locked, mula aturan dikonfirmasi.

l-e-m2-b04-11.goal: Delengen akèh conto comparative saka tembung pungkasan y, terangna aturan sing ditemokake, banjur priksa nganggo conto anyar.
l-e-m2-b04-11.material: happy → happier, easy → easier, busy → busier, heavy → heavier. Golekana aturan saka conto lan temtokna comparative saka funny.
l-e-m2-b04-11.s.s1.r.a: Funniest iku superlative. Conto-conto kuwi comparative.
l-e-m2-b04-11.s.s1.r.b: Aturan ngganti y dadi i ora diterapake.

l-e-m2-b04-12.material: I am good at drawing. We are afraid of failing. Thank you for helping. They talked about moving. Golekana aturan saka conto lan terapna ing ukara ing ngisor iki.

l-e-m2-b04-14.title: Aturan nggunakake for lan since
l-e-m2-b04-14.goal: Delengen akèh conto for lan since ing present perfect, terangna aturan sing ditemokake, banjur priksa nganggo conto anyar.
l-e-m2-b04-14.material: We have lived here for three years. We have waited since 8 o'clock. We have studied for two hours. We have played since Monday. Golekana aturan lan terapna.
l-e-m2-b04-14.s.s1.r.b: Ing present perfect, titik wiwitané nganggo since, dudu from.
l-e-m2-b04-14.s.s1.r.c: Sawisé for ana suwéné wektu, dudu titik wektu kaya last summer.
l-e-m2-b04-14.s.s1.r.d: During dudu tembung sing nuduhake titik wiwitan.
l-e-m2-b04-14.s.s1.explain: Gunakna for sadurunge suwéné wektu (three years) lan since sadurunge wektu wiwitan (8 o'clock, Monday).
l-e-m2-b04-14.s.s2.model.0: Ing conto, for digunakake sadurunge suwéné wektu lan since sadurunge wektu wiwitan, mula sadurunge last summer nganggo since.
l-e-m2-b04-14.s.s2.model.1: Last summer iku titik wiwitan, mula since bener. For mung digunakake karo suwéné wektu.

l-e-m2-b04-15.title: Aturan past participle kanggo eaten lan seen
l-e-m2-b04-15.goal: Delengen akèh conto nemokake past participle saka drive, terangna aturan sing ditemokake, banjur priksa nganggo conto anyar.
l-e-m2-b04-15.material: eat → eaten, see → seen, take → taken, write → written. have mapan sadurunge past participle iki. Gunakna aturan saka conto kanggo nemtokake past participle saka drive.
l-e-m2-b04-15.s.s1.prompt: I have ___ a bus before. Endi sing bener?
l-e-m2-b04-15.s.s1.r.a: Iki wujud biasa sing ditambahi -ed. Conto-conto pungkasané -n.
l-e-m2-b04-15.s.s1.r.b: Drove iku wujud kepungkur. Past participle ing conto pungkasané -n.
l-e-m2-b04-15.s.s1.explain: Past participle ing conto kabèh pungkasané -n utawa -en. Drive uga dadi driven.
l-e-m2-b04-15.s.s2.model.0: Past participle ing conto kabèh pungkasané -en, mula driven uga bener kanggo drive.
l-e-m2-b04-15.s.s2.model.1: Wanguné nganggo -en, kaya eaten, taken, lan written, mula sawisé have ana driven.

l-e-m2-b05-11.goal: Golekana lan tulisen aturan saka sawetara conto comparative adverb sing pungkasané -ly, banjur priksa nganggo conto anyar.
l-e-m2-b05-11.material: slowly → more slowly, quickly → more quickly, carefully → more carefully. Temokake aturan saka conto kasebut lan pilih comparative saka gently.
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s1.prompt: Apa comparative sing bener saka gently?
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s1.r.a: Gentle iku tembung sipat. Ing conto, -ly tetep digunakake.
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s1.r.b: Ora ana aturan nambahake -er ing conto kasebut.
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s1.r.c: Kanggo adverb pungkasan -ly, aja nambah -ier. Lebokna more ing ngarepe.
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s1.explain: Adverb sing pungkasané -ly mbentuk comparative kanthi nyelehake more ing ngarep. Gently dadi more gently.
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s2.model.0: Ing conto, more dilebokake ing ngarepe adverb -ly, mula gently uga dadi more gently.
l-e-m2-b05-11.s.s2.model.1: Kaya slowly lan quickly, -ly tetep lan digunakake bebarengan karo more, mula comparative saka gently yaiku more gently.

l-e-m2-b05-12.s.s2.model.1: Sawisé for ana wong, kaya easy for me lan hard for kids, mula jawabane for them.

l-e-m2-b05-14.title: Aturan kanggo njawab pitakon present perfect
l-e-m2-b05-14.goal: Golekana lan tulisen aturan kanggo jawaban cekak saka pitakon present perfect adhedhasar sawetara conto, banjur priksa nganggo conto anyar.
l-e-m2-b05-14.material: Has the bus left? — Yes, it has. / No, it hasn’t. Have the kids arrived? — Yes, they have. Temokake aturan saka conto lan gunakake kanggo ukara ing ngisor.
l-e-m2-b05-14.s.s1.prompt: Has the train arrived? — No, ___. Endi sing cocog?
l-e-m2-b05-14.s.s1.r.a: Kita mangsuli pitakon present perfect nganggo has, dudu did.
l-e-m2-b05-14.s.s1.r.b: Yen subjeké it, gunakake has, dudu have.
l-e-m2-b05-14.s.s1.r.d: Mung ana siji sepur, mula gunakake it, dudu they.
l-e-m2-b05-14.s.s1.explain: Baleni has/have saka pitakon, lan ganti jejer dadi pronomina kaya it utawa they. Has the train arrived? → No, it hasn’t.
l-e-m2-b05-14.s.s2.model.0: Ing conto, has saka pitakon dibaleni lan barang tunggal diganti dadi it, mula No, it hasn’t iku bener.
l-e-m2-b05-14.s.s2.model.1: Mung ana siji sepur lan pitakon diwiwiti nganggo has, mula wangsulane it hasn’t, nganggo hasn’t.

l-e-m2-b06-11.material: It is getting colder and colder. The sky is getting darker and darker. The story gets more and more exciting. Goleki aturan saka conto kasebut lan gunakake kanggo heavy.
l-e-m2-b06-11.s.s1.prompt: The bag gets ___ (heavy). Wangsulan endi sing bener?
l-e-m2-b06-11.s.s1.r.a: Tembung kasebut durung diowahi dadi comparative. Ing conto, comparative diulang.
l-e-m2-b06-11.s.s1.r.b: heavy iku tembung cekak, mula dadi heavier, dudu more.
l-e-m2-b06-11.s.s1.explain: “comparative and comparative” tegesé “dadi saya ~”. Wujude heavier and heavier.
l-e-m2-b06-11.s.s2.model.0: Ing conto, comparative diulang nganggo and, mula heavy uga dadi heavier and heavier.
l-e-m2-b06-11.s.s2.model.1: Wangun comparative katon kaping pindho kaya colder and colder, mula wujude heavier and heavier.

l-e-m2-b06-12.thinking.1: Tuliskan aturan yang kamu temukan dengan kata-kata
l-e-m2-b06-12.thinking.2: Periksa dengan menerapkan aturan pada kasus baru

l-e-m2-b06-12.s.s1.hint.1: Terapkan aturan yang kamu temukan pada kasus berikutnya dan periksa apakah benar.

l-e-m2-b06-12.s.s2.hint.0: Pertama, tuliskan aturan itu dalam satu kalimat.
l-e-m2-b06-12.s.s2.hint.1: Berikan dua kasus atau lebih yang sesuai dengan aturan itu.

l-e-m2-b06-12.title: Aturan sawisé make lan let
l-e-m2-b06-12.goal: Saka sawetara conto wangun kriya sawisé make, let, lan help, goleki lan tulisen aturan, banjur priksa nganggo conto anyar.
l-e-m2-b06-12.material: Mom made me clean my room. The teacher let us go home. Music helps me relax. Goleki aturan saka conto lan gunakake ing ukara ngisor iki.
l-e-m2-b06-12.s.s1.prompt: The movie made us ___. Wangsulan endi sing bener?
l-e-m2-b06-12.s.s1.r.a: Aja nganggo wangun lampau sawisé wong kasebut.
l-e-m2-b06-12.s.s1.r.c: Ing conto, kriya wangun dhasar ana sawisé wong, dudu -ing.
l-e-m2-b06-12.s.s1.r.d: Ing conto, ora ana to sawisé wong.
l-e-m2-b06-12.s.s1.explain: Sawisé wong sing ngetutake make, let, lan help, gunakake wangun dhasar kriya tanpa to. Dadi made us cry.
l-e-m2-b06-12.s.s2.model.0: Ing conto wangun dhasar kriya ana sawisé wong tanpa to, mula cry iku bener sawisé made us.
l-e-m2-b06-12.s.s2.model.1: Wangun dhasar langsung ngetutake wong, kaya made me clean lan let us go, mula wujude made us cry.

l-e-m2-b06-13.title: Aturan ukara pasif nganggo preposisi
l-e-m2-b06-13.goal: Saka sawetara conto pasif saka kriya sing nduweni preposisi, goleki lan tulisen aturan, banjur priksa nganggo conto anyar.
l-e-m2-b06-13.material: The baby was looked after by a nurse. The idea was talked about by everyone. The joke was laughed at by the class. Goleki aturan saka conto lan gunakake.
l-e-m2-b06-13.s.s1.r.b: Preposisi to ilang. Ing conto, preposisine tetep ana.
l-e-m2-b06-13.s.s1.r.c: Preposisi ana sawisé kriya, dudu sadurunge.
l-e-m2-b06-13.s.s1.r.d: Preposisine owah saka to dadi at.
l-e-m2-b06-13.s.s1.explain: Kanggo kriya sing nduweni preposisi, preposisine tetep ana sawisé kriya sanajan ing ukara pasif. Wujude was listened to.
l-e-m2-b06-13.s.s2.model.0: Ing conto preposisine tetep langsung sawisé kriya, mula was listened to iku bener.
l-e-m2-b06-13.s.s2.model.1: Kaya looked after lan talked about, preposisine tetep ana, mula to uga tetep ing listened to.

l-e-m2-b06-14.title: Aturan panggonan just
l-e-m2-b06-14.goal: Saka sawetara conto panggonan just, goleki lan tulisen aturane, banjur priksa nganggo conto anyar.
l-e-m2-b06-14.material: I have just eaten. The bus has just left. They have just arrived. Goleki aturan saka conto lan pilih ukara sing bener.
l-e-m2-b06-14.s.s1.prompt: Ukara endi sing tegesé “Aku lagi wae rampung”?
l-e-m2-b06-14.s.s1.r.c: just ora ana ing wiwitan ukara.
l-e-m2-b06-14.s.s1.r.d: just ana ing antarane have lan past participle, dudu ing pungkasan ukara.
l-e-m2-b06-14.s.s1.explain: just ana ing antarane have/has lan past participle. Wujude I have just finished.
l-e-m2-b06-14.s.s2.model.0: Ing conto, just ana ing antarane have lan past participle, mula I have just finished iku bener.
l-e-m2-b06-14.s.s2.model.1: Kaya ing have just eaten, just ana ing tengah, mula dadi have just finished.

l-e-m2-b06-15.title: Aturan tegesé tembung pungkasan -er
l-e-m2-b06-15.goal: Goleki aturan saka sawetara conto tegesé tembung sing pungkasan -er, tulisen, banjur priksa nganggo conto anyar.
l-e-m2-b06-15.material: A teacher minangka wong sing mulang. A painter minangka wong sing nglukis. A farmer minangka wong tani. Goleki aturan saka conto lan kira-kira tegesé runner.
l-e-m2-b06-15.s.s1.r.b: -er ora nduweni teges negatif. Tegesé wong sing nindakake.
l-e-m2-b06-15.s.s1.r.c: -er nuduhake wong sing nindakake samubarang, dudu wektu.
l-e-m2-b06-15.s.s1.explain: -er sawisé kriya nambahake teges “wong sing nindakake”. Runner yaiku wong sing mlayu.
l-e-m2-b06-15.s.s2.model.0: Ing conto, -er nambahake teges wong sing nindakake, mula runner yaiku wong sing mlayu.
l-e-m2-b06-15.s.s2.model.1: Amarga -er sawisé teach, paint, lan farm nuduhake wong, -er sawisé run uga tegesé wong sing mlayu.

l-e-m2-b07-03.title: Comparative adjektiva pungkasan y
l-e-m2-b07-03.goal: Golekana lan terangna aturan saka sawetara conto comparative lan superlative adjektiva pungkasan y, banjur priksa nganggo conto anyar.
l-e-m2-b07-03.material: happy → happier → happiest. easy → easier → easiest. busy → busier → busiest. Golekana aturan saka conto lan terapna marang funny.
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s1.prompt: Endi comparative lan superlative funny sing bener?
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s1.r.a: y tetep lan mung ditambahi -er lan -est.
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s1.r.b: Sampeyan nggunakake more/most, dudu aturan adjektiva pungkasan -y.
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s1.r.d: y tetep, ditambahi i, lan uga salah nyampur ejaan.
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s1.explain: Yen tembung pungkasané konsonan + y, ganti y dadi i banjur tambahna -er lan -est.
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s2.model.0: Ing happy, easy, lan busy, y dadi i banjur ditambahi -er, mula funny dadi funnier lan funniest.
l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s2.model.1: Ing kabèh conto, y dadi i lan owah dadi -ier lan -iest, mula funny uga manut aturan sing padha.

l-e-m2-b01-16.thinking.0: Ubah menjadi bilangan yang mudah dipakai untuk memperkirakan
l-e-m2-b01-16.thinking.2: Jelaskan mengapa perkiraan itu masuk akal

l-e-m2-b01-16.title: Suwene pira kanggo maca teks?
l-e-m2-b01-16.goal: Taksir suwene wektu kanggo maca kabeh teks, pilih kira-kira rentang sing trep, lan terangna alesane.
l-e-m2-b01-16.material: Teks dumadi saka 5 paragraf, saben paragraf kira-kira 60 tembung. Siji murid maca kira-kira 120 tembung sajrone 1 menit.
l-e-m2-b01-16.s.s1.prompt: Pira taksiran sing paling trep kanggo wektu maca kabeh teks?
l-e-m2-b01-16.s.s1.r.a: Yen 10 menit, mung 30 tembung sing diwaca sajrone 1 menit.
l-e-m2-b01-16.s.s1.r.c: Yen 30 menit, mung 10 tembung sing diwaca sajrone 1 menit.
l-e-m2-b01-16.s.s1.r.d: Yen 30 detik, kudu maca 600 tembung sajrone 1 menit.
l-e-m2-b01-16.s.s1.explain: 5×60=300 tembung, lan kanthi kacepetan 120 tembung sajrone 1 menit, 300÷120=2.5 menit.
l-e-m2-b01-16.s.s2.model.0: Maca 300 tembung kanthi kacepetan 120 tembung sajrone 1 menit mbutuhake kira-kira 2.5 menit, mula 2-3 menit iku trep.
l-e-m2-b01-16.s.s2.model.1: 120 tembung mbutuhake 1 menit, lan 300 mung luwih saka kaping pindho 120, mula suwene kira-kira 2 setengah menit.

l-e-m2-b01-17.title: Wis latihan ping pira?
l-e-m2-b01-17.goal: Taksir pira sesi latihan sing wis ditindakake nganti saiki, pilih kira-kira angka utawa rentang sing trep, lan terangna alesane.
l-e-m2-b01-17.material: Klub renang miwiti latihan 3 minggu kepungkur. Saben minggu latihan 4 nganti 5 dina. “Kita wis latihan kira-kira ___ kaping.”
l-e-m2-b01-17.s.s1.prompt: Taksiran endi sing paling trep kanggo ngisi papan kosong?
l-e-m2-b01-17.s.s1.r.b: Sanajan latihan saben dina suwene 3 minggu, mung 21 kaping, mula angka iki kakehan.
l-e-m2-b01-17.s.s1.r.c: Angka iki gedhé banget kanggo wektu 3 minggu.
l-e-m2-b01-17.s.s1.explain: 3 minggu × 4 nganti 5 kaping tegesé antarane 12 lan 15 kaping.
l-e-m2-b01-17.s.s2.model.0: Amarga latihané 4 nganti 5 kaping saben minggu suwéné 3 minggu, cacahé saka 3×4=12 nganti 3×5=15, yaiku 12 nganti 15 kaping.
l-e-m2-b01-17.s.s2.model.1: Nglumpukaké 4 utawa 5 kaping saben minggu suwéné telung minggu dadi watara 12 nganti 15 kaping.

l-e-m2-b01-21.goal: Tututana langkah solusi sing ngowahi ukara aktif dadi pasif, utawa ranté sebab-akibat, kanthi urut, temokna lan benerna panggonan pisanan sing salah.
l-e-m2-b01-21.material: Owahana 'The cat chased the mouse.' dadi pasif: ① Tulis The mouse dhisik. ② Iki kala kepungkur, mula gunakna was. ③ Gunakna wangun dhasar chase minangka tembung kriya. ④ Tambahna by the cat. → The mouse was chase by the cat.
l-e-m2-b01-21.s.s1.r.a: ① bener. Obyèk pindhah menyang posisi subyèk.
l-e-m2-b01-21.s.s1.o.b: Langkah sing nganggo was amarga kala kepungkur (②)
l-e-m2-b01-21.s.s1.r.b: ② bener. Pasif kala kepungkur nganggo was.
l-e-m2-b01-21.s.s1.o.c: Langkah sing nganggo wangun dhasar tembung kriya (③)
l-e-m2-b01-21.s.s1.r.d: ④ bener. Sing nindakaké ditulis nganggo by.
l-e-m2-b01-21.s.s1.explain: Swara pasif butuh past participle. Gunakna chased, dudu chase, supaya dadi was chased.
l-e-m2-b01-21.s.s2.model.0: Ing ③ digunakaké wangun dhasar chase, nanging pasif butuh past participle, mula benerna dadi was chased.
l-e-m2-b01-21.s.s2.model.1: Sawisé was kudu chased, mula ③ minangka kaluputan pisanan lan The mouse was chased by the cat iku bener.

l-e-m2-b01-25.s.s1.r.a: ① persis kaya katrangan ing teks.
l-e-m2-b01-25.s.s1.r.c: ③ dudutan bener yèn ② bener, mula dudu panggonan salah pisanan.
l-e-m2-b01-25.s.s1.r.d: Ana kaluputan. Coba etung manèh wektu tekane.
l-e-m2-b01-25.s.s1.explain: 8:30 ditambah 15 menit iku 8:45, mula ② salah. Kelas diwiwiti 8:40, mula murid telat 5 menit.
l-e-m2-b01-25.s.s2.model.0: 8:30 ditambah 15 menit iku 8:45, mula ② salah, lan amarga luwih saka 8:40, murid telat.
l-e-m2-b01-25.s.s2.model.1: 8:35 ing ② iku kaluputan petungan. Kuduné 8:45, mula murid teka sawisé kelas diwiwiti lan telat.
